(def hash (fn [o]
  (cond
    (implements? IHash o)
    (bit-xor (-hash o) 0)

    (number? o)
    (if (suss.bootstrap/f64-finite o)
      (if-not (suss.bootstrap/f64-safe-integer o)
        (hash-double o)
        (suss.bootstrap/safe-integer-remainder (suss.bootstrap/f64-floor o) 2147483647))
      (case o
        ##Inf
        2146435072
        ##-Inf
        -1048576
        2146959360))

    ;; note: mirrors Clojure's behavior on the JVM, where the hashCode is
    ;; 1231 for true and 1237 for false
    ;; http://docs.oracle.com/javase/7/docs/api/java/lang/Boolean.html#hashCode%28%29
    (true? o) 1231

    (false? o) 1237

    (string? o)
    (m3-hash-int (hash-string o))

    (instance? BootstrapDate o)
    (bit-xor (.valueOf o) 0)

    (nil? o) 0

    :else
    (bit-xor (-hash o) 0))))

A descriptor-backed BootstrapDate replaces host Date identity; its valueOf method reads TimeClip-normalized numeric milliseconds. No Date branch is removed.
